boards.title: Your First Weekend at Monmouth University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-pressure, under-21-safe sequence for orienting yourself to campus, finding shared spaces, and checking the current event calendar.

cards.entity_name: The Great Hall at Shadow Lawn
cards.title: 1. Start with the Great Hall grounds
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · campus orientation
cards.notes: Begin outside the map-listed Great Hall at Shadow Lawn, then use the campus map to locate nearby academic and student-life destinations before heading farther out.
cards.short_summary: Use a landmark stop to get your bearings on Monmouth’s campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Monmouth’s official campus map lists The Great Hall at Shadow Lawn as a campus location.
cards.access_notes: View the official map before going; access to building interiors may vary.

cards.entity_name: Murry and Leonie Guggenheim Memorial Library
cards.title: 2. Settle in at Guggenheim Library
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · study-space reset
cards.notes: Walk to the map-listed Guggenheim Memorial Library, find a comfortable public study area, and save its hours page for a later research or reading session.
cards.short_summary: Make the library your reliable base for a quiet first-weekend pause.
cards.evidence_claim: The library lists normal fall and spring hours, including Friday until 7 p.m., Saturday 10 a.m.–6 p.m., and Sunday 11 a.m.–midnight.
cards.source_title: Frequently Asked Questions | Guggenheim Memorial Library
cards.access_notes: Normal semester hours are posted by the library; check for closures or changes before visiting.

cards.title: 3. Learn the Student Center layout
cards.subtitle: Friday late afternoon · campus connections
cards.notes: Stop at the map-listed Rebecca Stafford Student Center to identify Student Engagement and student-support offices, then check posted or digital campus programming.
cards.short_summary: Put the campus gathering place on your mental map early.
cards.evidence_claim: Monmouth’s undergraduate catalog describes the Student Center as a gathering area and lists student services housed there.
cards.source_title: Student Organizations | Monmouth University Undergraduate Catalog
cards.access_notes: Office and building access can vary; consult current campus information on arrival.

cards.title: 4. Have an early dinner at Magill Commons
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · meal break
cards.notes: Use the map-listed Magill Commons Dining Hall for a straightforward meal break, and confirm the current dining schedule or meal-plan options before you go.
cards.short_summary: Anchor the evening with a campus dining stop before any scheduled program.
cards.evidence_claim: Monmouth’s student handbook identifies Magill Commons Dining Hall as a buffet-style dining location and posts its regular meal hours.
cards.source_title: Campus Services | Monmouth University Student Handbook
cards.access_notes: Regular handbook hours list Friday 7 a.m.–8 p.m. and weekend hours 10 a.m.–8 p.m.; confirm current service.

cards.title: 5. Check Pollak Theatre and Art Gallery
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · arts-calendar check
cards.notes: Visit the map-listed Pollak Theatre and Art Gallery area, then use the University’s events calendar to see whether a current exhibition or performance fits your weekend.
cards.short_summary: Turn an arts venue into a flexible, schedule-led evening option.
cards.evidence_claim: Monmouth’s official campus map lists Pollak Theatre and Art Gallery among its art locations.
cards.access_notes: Events, admission, and gallery access vary; confirm the specific listing before attending.

cards.title: 6. Take a Saturday garden walk
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · outdoor pause
cards.notes: Find Erlanger Gardens on the official campus map and take a daylight walk through the grounds; stay on open paths and respect any posted access guidance.
cards.short_summary: Choose a calm outdoor campus stop before busier weekend plans.
cards.evidence_claim: Monmouth’s official campus map lists Erlanger Gardens as a garden location.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor access may be affected by weather, maintenance, or posted restrictions.

cards.title: 7. Continue to the sculpture garden
cards.subtitle: Saturday midday · campus art outdoors
cards.notes: Continue with the map-listed Lois Blonder Sculpture Garden and spend a few minutes looking closely at the outdoor works before choosing your next campus stop.
cards.short_summary: Add an outdoor art pause to the walk without needing a fixed event time.
cards.evidence_claim: Monmouth’s official campus map lists the Lois Blonder Sculpture Garden as a garden location.
cards.access_notes: Visit during daylight and follow all posted guidance for the grounds.

cards.title: 8. See what is on at OceanFirst Bank Center
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon or evening · scheduled event option
cards.notes: Check the current athletics or events listing, then go to the map-listed OceanFirst Bank Center only if a suitable public event is scheduled for your weekend.
cards.short_summary: Use the arena as a calendar-driven option, not an assumed event.
cards.evidence_claim: Monmouth states that OceanFirst Bank Center hosts athletic events, concerts, family shows, and special events.
cards.source_title: Concerts + Events FAQ | OceanFirst Bank Center
cards.access_notes: Attendance, tickets, and student ID requirements depend on the specific event; verify directly with the event listing.

cards.entity_name: Henni Kantor Kessler & John H. Kessler Stadium
cards.title: 9. Add Kessler Stadium to your route
cards.subtitle: Sunday afternoon · athletics landmark
cards.notes: Walk by the map-listed Kessler Stadium and, if a public home event is scheduled, check the official athletics information for entry details before attending.
cards.short_summary: Recognize a major campus athletics venue while keeping plans schedule-aware.
cards.evidence_claim: Monmouth identifies Kessler Stadium as hosting football, men’s and women’s lacrosse, and outdoor track and field.
cards.access_notes: Do not assume an event or open seating; confirm the event and venue policies before entering.

cards.title: 10. Finish by choosing one campus event
cards.subtitle: Sunday evening · plan the next connection
cards.notes: Open the Office of Student Engagement events information or Hawk Hub, choose one under-21-safe upcoming program, and add it to your calendar for the following week.
cards.short_summary: End the weekend with one concrete next step toward campus involvement.
cards.evidence_claim: The Office of Student Engagement directs students to Hawk Hub, campus email, and its channels for events, and describes programming including festivals, open mics, novelty nights, bingo, and first-year programming.
cards.source_title: Office of Student Engagement | Monmouth University
cards.access_notes: Choose a currently listed event and review its attendance requirements before going.
